articles.text: Receptionist: Hello, Pensione Giannetti. Good morning.
Customer: Buongiorno. Vorrei parlare con la signora Mindorf, per favore.
Customer: Good morning. I would like to speak with Mrs. Mindorf, please.
Receptionist: Qual è il numero della stanza?
Receptionist: What is the room number?
Customer: Non lo so. È arrivata ieri.
Customer: I don't know. She arrived yesterday.
Customer: No, no. Mindorf. M come Milano...
Customer: No, no. Mindorf. M as in Milan...
Receptionist: Ah, va bene. Le passo la stanza.
Receptionist: Ah, all right. I'll connect you to the room.
